assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and fatigue consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, sick sinus syndrome, and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded I48.0.
The diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome is coded I49.5.
The diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is coded CPT 93247.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated due to the intermittent nature of the arrhythmias and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period.
The service is medically necessary and directly addresses the clinical indication documented for this episode.
The prior authorization requirement is identified by Reason Code CO-197.
The prior authorization requirement does not negate the medical necessity of the service rendered.
